Hi Olga,

Attached is the remittance advice for the payment released on 2027-10-25 via our UK treasury team. The payment covered multiple invoices but was sent as a single batch by our bank. For our records and your application:

- Payment amount (gross): GBP 112,500.00
- Bank reference: ACME-1125-20271025
- Bank advice attached (screenshot of wire confirmation)

I included a short mapping in the PDF, but please confirm that the payment will be applied to the following invoices as intended:

1) INV-2027-0412 — GBP 45,000.00
2) INV-2027-0430 — GBP 37,500.00
3) INV-2027-0451 — GBP 30,000.00

There is a VAT element on INV-2027-0430 (reverse charge) and on INV-2027-0451 (standard VAT). Our intent was to remit net of VAT where appropriate; if you need a VAT breakdown to post to your ledger, let me know and Ill send the payment CSV.

Hi Marco — thanks for sending this through.

We can apply the payment to the three invoices you listed but need two quick clarifications before I post it:

1) Are the amounts in the PDF gross of VAT or net? The line totals in the remittance PDF look like gross amounts but the bank advice shows the net transfer.
2) For INV-2027-0430 (reverse charge): can you confirm whether ACME expects Redwood to reclaim VAT (reverse-charge) or if ACME is accounting for it on its side? We want to ensure the VAT codes we use match your filings.

If you can also send the raw CSV with the bank reference (one line per invoice) that will speed up automated application in our ledger.

Once I have that Ill loop in Finance (laura) to apply and confirm the final posting reference.

Regards,

Thanks Olga — sorry for the confusion. Ive attached the CSV export from our payment system that shows the per-invoice mapping and the exact transferred amounts (all GBP). Key points:

- CSV line for INV-2027-0412 shows GBP 45,000.00 (no VAT)
- CSV line for INV-2027-0430 shows GBP 31,250.00 (net) + GBP 6,250.00 VAT (reverse-charge indicator set)
- CSV line for INV-2027-0451 shows GBP 27,000.00 (net) + GBP 3,000.00 VAT (standard VAT)

We paid the gross total of GBP 112,500.00. The bank reference (ACME-1125-20271025) is included on every line in the file so you can match easily.

Attachments: acme_remit_mapping_20271028.csv (csv)

Ive also created a quick DocuSign link for a small invoice amendment on INV-2027-0451 — thats optional but it clarifies the VAT line if your ERP requires a supporting doc: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/view?envelopeId=3f2b1c4a-...

Let me know when you have applied the payment and if we owe any withholding or need to issue a credit for banking fees.

Best,
Marco

Olga / team — posted and allocated this morning. Summary of posting in our ledger:

- Applied bank reference ACME-1125-20271025 to the following GL lines:
  * INV-2027-0412: GBP 45,000.00 — posted to AR:Sales (no VAT code)
  * INV-2027-0430: GBP 31,250.00 net / GBP 6,250.00 (reverse-charge VAT indicator) — posted to AR:Sales and VAT:ReverseCharge (code RC-UK)
  * INV-2027-0451: GBP 27,000.00 net / GBP 3,000.00 VAT — posted to AR:Sales and VAT:Standard (code STD-UK)

- Banking fees: GBP 12.50 — absorbed by ACME per your payment CSV (we noted a small fee on the transfer). If you want that credited back, confirm and we can issue a credit memo.

Attached: application_note_olga_20271029.xlsx (contains posting journal ID JRN-2027-1009 and transaction IDs).

Next steps:
- Marco: please confirm you are happy with the VAT codes above (RC-UK and STD-UK).
- Once confirmed, I will close the AR tickets and mark the invoices as paid in the portal.

Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
